summary.text: David Fraser-Hidalgo is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 15 who has served since October 21, 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fraser-Hidalgo advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Economic Matters Committee and the Unemployment Insurance Oversight Committee, and notes earlier service on the Environment and Transportation Committee.
